description: Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL configuration to run migrations.

type.description: The type of database to run migrations against.

default.description: Default configuration parameters to run migration.

additionalProperties.description: Environment specific configuration parameters to run migration.

run-environment-config.description: Per environment configuration parameters to run migration.

schema.description: The database schema to use for migrations.

username_ref.description: Secret Manager secret holding the database username. A bare name is read from the instance's project.

password_ref.description: Secret Manager secret holding the database password. A bare name is read from the instance's project.

endpoint.description: The Cloud SQL instance connection name (project:region:instance).
